scope: Necessary60 nominal input-switch paths under plan5c, after EXP065 short acceptance. Same single half-amplitude switch, original states/seeds/gates/steps/widths. No dynamic, comparator or tuning.
parameter_provenance: Minimal already-seen EXP057/059 nominal subset: ideal positive control, both-stage linear and both-stage smooth. Synthetic mechanism assumptions, no chip fit or independent curve holdout. Original numeric kernels reused unchanged.

input.formula: Use delivered EXP062 tone[n mod30720] before global n_s=3932160; exactly half of that double after n_s. Frequency127/30720 and continuous global phase unchanged. Only amplitude changes.

dither: Original independent counter streams 2 and 3, indexed by global conversion n, +/-1 with physical amplitudes1/32 at both preamp summing nodes. Periodic input is independent of declared tags; IID independence is a modeling assumption, not a proven property of SplitMix64/chip PRNG.

budget.comparison: 3 models x5 original seeds x2 methods x2 initializations. Carry prefix3932160 reused; fresh begins at same switch tag, no prefix. Full uses30x learning. Nochange long suffix is existing EXP062, not rerun. Long execution not implied by a preflight result.

preflight.nochange: Start at32766 with corresponding delivered states. Reproduce all34 windows of original unchanged input exactly.
preflight.carry: Start at32766 and reproduce2 prefix windows, switch amplitude at32768, continue32 windows without reset.
preflight.fresh: Start at32768 unit, new amplitude immediately,32 windows; pair future words exactly with carry.

verification.long_probe_schedule: First4 windows of each listed post block and final4 windows =28 per stream; all120 samples, original physical/readout/bank commit probes.
verification.digital: Every actual stored source word/tag, unit/online code, Q22 state transition, selected/all support and change counters. Original physical platform full short replay; later long physical source original probes plus all separate vector formulas.
verification.splice: Nochange all34 windows equal original words/output/Q22. Carry2-prefix equal original; switch state at boundary exactly original32768. Carry/fresh all32 future words and unit codes equal. Counter tag never reindexed.
verification.nominal_sha256: Every reused tone, protocol, validation, metadata, words, outputs and Q22 file checked against original delivery_hashes before use and verification; delivery manifest itself frozen.

empirical_convergence.definition: Offline only. Retain original separate3x8-block stability criterion. Recovery = first3 consecutive8-block groups where BOTH carry and fresh satisfy it, each paired group SNDR mean gap<=1dB, and absolute paired effective-state group mean gap<=0.005 on union of selected joint-supported coordinates. Report unsupported coordinates and later failures; criterion missing within128 blocks is censored, not divergence. Close but equally poor paths may pass: net unit benefit/MSE/SFDR separately reported. No oracle target or online stop.
empirical_convergence.origin: Predeclared mechanism criterion, reuse original tolerance for paired closeness; no chip/paper standard or q<1 proof.

evaluation: Long: use all128 post blocks of30720 conversions; first block is switch/start transient. Reuse original prefix blocks for context, never mix unequal amplitudes into one sine FFT. Continuous online output against own same-input unit reference, and carry versus fresh. Report MSE/DC/SNDR/SFDR, both dB and power averages, finite MSE/spectrum cross identities, per-block support and Q22/export changes, drift/covariance/time correlations. Short: no incomplete-block sine metrics, only word/state/support and exact sample MSE diagnostic; no recovery/performance claim.
predictions: Nochange splice exactly identical by window induction; carry/fresh post words identical under static feedforward plant independent of calibration state. Output/state need not become equal. Loss difference must retain fresh-error/state-output cross. Amplitude change does not assume monotone high-segment support or guaranteed recovery.
freeze: Long execution requires EXP065 passed verification and unchanged frozen sources; original delivery hashes checked. New protocol/runner/verifier/analyzer frozen before long. One128-block horizon only, no extension based on recovery. Copy all source/data manifests and preserve failed runs. Offline criteria/targets do not enter online updates.

switch.origin: Predetermined half of the existing 256-block horizon, not a selected stable state. Original128-block prefix reused with delivery SHA256, no retraining.
switch.carry: All eight integer Q22 accumulators, original global counter tags/streams2,3, phase and lane; no partial products at the120-slot boundary. Keep both method-specific states, export via original Q1.10. Original physical paths are static with zero memory; no applicable analog history state exists here.
switch.fresh: All eight Q22 states unit at SAME global n_s with SAME future tone/tag words. Does not restart PRNG/global phase. This control isolates inherited digital initialization.
